title: Property-Specific Recoverability from Contact PPG to Camera rPPG under Heterogeneous Observation Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2608.27392v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Camera-derived remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is commonly validated through endpoint accuracy, but endpoint performance does not establish whether other physiological properties of source contact photoplethysmography (PPG) remain preserved recording by recording. We evaluated property-specific PPG-to-rPPG recoverability on 655 recordings from the Multi-Domain Mobile Video Physiology Dataset using CHROM as a fixed camera-rPPG observation pathway. The pathway reproduced the published CHROM correlation regime, with heart-rate MAE of 15.26 bpm and Pearson correlation of 0.0801. Matched-versus-shuffled validation revealed modest recording-specific autocorrelation correspondence, while spectral and recurrence-rate measures showed little matched discrimination. translated_title: 异构观测条件下从接触式PPG到相机rPPG的属性特定可恢复性研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27392v1 公告类型：跨领域 摘要：基于相机的远程光电容积描记法（rPPG）通常通过端点准确性进行验证，但端点性能并不能确定源接触式光电容积描记法（PPG）的其他生理属性是否在逐次记录中得以保留。我们在多域移动视频生理数据集的655条记录上，使用CHROM作为固定的相机-rPPG观测路径，评估了属性特定的PPG到rPPG可恢复性。该路径复现了已发表的CHROM相关性机制，心率平均绝对误差为15.26次/分，皮尔逊相关系数为0.0801。匹配与打乱验证显示适度的记录特定自相关对应性，而频谱和复发率测量几乎没有匹配判别能力。最大李雅普诺夫指数在PPG到rPPG对应性上基本无记录特定关系，相关系数为0.0231，置换p值为0.5584，尽管群体水平上存在差异。
tldr: 本研究通过CHROM路径评估了PPG到rPPG的属性特定可恢复性，发现心率等端点指标可复现，但非线性动态属性（如最大李雅普诺夫指数）在逐记录层面几乎不可恢复，表明rPPG可能无法保留源信号的全部生理特性。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates property-specific PPG-to-rPPG recoverability via CHROM, finding that endpoint metrics like heart rate are reproducible, but nonlinear dynamic properties (e.g., maximal Lyapunov exponents) show negligible recording-specific recoverability, suggesting rPPG may not preserve all physiological characteristics of the source signal.
